issues.what: First Sealand dynasty drawn as the 42-50 E x 27-32.3 N rectangle (1,599 cells, 404,000 km2: northern Arabia, Kuwait, Khuzestan) on top of Cliopatria's 15,392 km2 Gulf-head shape; it cut Elam's Susiana (122 cells, the m1400 window's Elam snap) and Babylonia's own land. The page finds Sealand pottery only at Girsu, Uruk and Lagash 'but in no site north of that'. Replaced by Cliopatria's -1500 core plus Dhi-Qar, Basra, Uruk, Nippur and Isin, the land m1600-m1501 gave -1600 (keyframe equals the anchor).

babylonia_-1460 (Cliopatria's -1500 shape 'with the Sealand and Sumer') excludes Cliopatria's own Sealand core, so the keyframe cut 1,330 ledger cells (76 after the Sealand fix: Basra 55, Kuwait 11, Khuzestan 5) out of the land the Kassites had just taken. Now the shape plus the corrected Sealand land: the snap is gone.

Four cells of Nippur's disc north of 32.3 N (outside the rectangle of babylonia ledger/11) stayed with the Sealand at -1460: R2 (the Sealand lists Babylonia as predecessor) gave them to it at the keyframe and its dissolve left them to nobody, a hole in Babylonia at Nippur to the window's end (and the new babylonia/first-sealand conflict of 4 cell-years).

Minoan civilization's -1500 keyframe is Cliopatria's 16-cell Crete shape, but the dossier's own end (-1450) and mycenaean-greece ledger/2 take the whole island (27 cells); m1600-m1501 already made Crete whole at -1600 (anchor). Carried to -1500 and to the Mycenaean -1450 keyframe, which otherwise cut 11 Cretan cells back out (snap).

Miletus: the 4 cells of the Mycenaean settlement (ledger/3) went to Arzawa by the size rule, because Arzawa's keyframe is only a 100 km disc round Ephesus; the page: 'Miletus was a Mycenaean stronghold on the coast of Asia Minor from c. 1450 to 1100 BC', and Arzawa is 'nearby'. A ruling settled the cells but left a keyframe snap, so an event takes them from Arzawa instead.

new-kingdom-of-egypt_-1500 snap (+1,357 cells: Western Desert 692, Red Sea 293, Sinai 95; -465: western Northern Sudan 401): the -1550 Nile-Valley keyframe plus the ledger's Nubia box is narrower than the dossier's deliberate 'as drawn' Cliopatria shape, so Egypt jumps from 1,240 to 2,385 cells on 1 Jan -1500 with no event. The shape is the dossier's reviewed choice and looks right (Nubia to the Fourth Cataract, Gaza coast); the western-Sudan desert it drops is not Egyptian on any page seen.

assyria_-1500 snap (101 cells, Salah ad-Din 87, to nobody) and babylonia_-1500 snap (29 cells, Diyala 25, to nobody): Cliopatria's own shrinking of both shapes at -1500; the dossiers say the pages are silent on the year and the land (Assur subjugated by Mitanni only c. 1430).

Size-rule conflicts: new-kingdom-of-egypt/qatna (Beqaa, North Lebanon, 9 cell-years), kingdom-of-mycenae and kingdom-of-pylos vs mycenaean-greece (members inside the overlord), mitanni/ugarit (Lattakia 6), hittites/kaska (Amasya 2), assyria/babylonia (Diyala 1): the smaller state won, as the dossiers' regions say.

Contests: kaska/hittites open from -1430 to the end of the window (next window's business); mitanni/egypt over Aleppo -1445..-1438 closes. First-sealand-dynasty -1500 keyframe adds 15 cells at its start year (Kuwait 10, Khuzestan 5), Cliopatria's own growth of the shape from 13,101 km2 (-1600) to 15,392 km2 (-1500).
